# Shipyard

> Shipyard is a browser-based deployment and management platform for GenLayer
> Intelligent Contracts. Developers can upload or generate Python contracts,
> configure constructor parameters, deploy them, inspect live logs, and interact
> with deployed contracts without using a CLI.

Shipyard is open source and available at https://genshipyard.com. It supports
four selectable environments: Testnet Bradbury, Testnet Asimov, Studionet, and
Localnet. Testnet Clarke is represented as coming soon and is not selectable.

## Primary resources

- [Shipyard home](https://genshipyard.com/): Product overview and supported workflow.
- [Deploy](https://genshipyard.com/deploy): Upload, generate, configure, and deploy an Intelligent Contract.
- [Templates](https://genshipyard.com/templates): Ready-to-deploy Python Intelligent Contract examples.
- [Contract registry](https://genshipyard.com/registry): Public contracts and recent verified activity.
- [Builders](https://genshipyard.com/builders): Builder reputation and verified deployment profiles.
- [Network comparison](https://genshipyard.com/compare): Compare contract deployment across supported testnets.
- [Shipyard skills](https://genshipyard.com/skills): Agent-oriented deployment, discovery, interaction, and verification workflows.
- [GenLayer Knowledge Center](https://genshipyard.com/blog): Technical guides about Intelligent Contracts, AI consensus, machine trust, and agent-ready applications.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/luch91/shipyard): Application source and developer documentation.

## Product facts

- Intelligent Contracts are Python-based contracts for GenLayer.
- Hosted targets do not require a local GenLayer stack.
- Localnet requires a local GenLayer node at `localhost:4000`.
- Wallet transactions are approved in the user's connected wallet.
- Shipyard never requests or stores private keys or seed phrases.
- Public wallet authentication uses SIWE.
- The admin console uses a separate password session, with an optional allowlisted-wallet fallback.
